project_name: CloudBurst San Marcos Data Center I
status_detail: CloudBurst/Evolve announced groundbreaking for San Marcos Data Center I in November 2025; the campus is in Hays and Guadalupe counties, master-planned for up to 1.2 GW, with first 50 MW phase targeted for Q4 2026. Energy Transfer/CloudBurst also announced up to 450,000 MMBtu/day gas supply for direct power.
notes: Campus straddles/implicates both Hays and Guadalupe Counties; retained here because the batch county is Hays and sources explicitly include Hays County.

project_name: Diode Ventures Cedar Creek Lake data center site
aliases: Trinidad / Cedar Creek Reservoir data center
status_detail: Diode Ventures wrote Henderson County officials on July 22, 2026 that after evaluating a potential data center site near Cedar Creek Lake it would not pursue land development at that location. KLTV reported the site was near Trinidad/Cedar Creek Reservoir and that Henderson County commissioners had earlier passed a safeguards resolution after public opposition.
notes: Marked rejected/withdrawn because the developer's letter says it will not pursue this location; county-level resolution was not a project approval or denial vote.
